summary.motive: Counter 3x1 Trips formations and flood concepts that typically stress single-high Cover 3 by deploying split-field Quarters to the field and Cover 2 to the boundary.
summary.keyDefender: RCB (Field Corner) & SS (Field Safety) in Quarters bracket technique
summary.whyItWorks: Trips flood concepts rely on putting the Cover 3 corner in a 2-on-1 bind; Cover 6 splits the field so three field defenders handle the three-level route combination.
summary.failureMode: Boundary boundary-smash or power run game targeting the 2-high light box.

beats.title: Split-Field Two-High Pre-Snap Shell
beats.text: Unlike Cover 3 Match, Saleh aligns in a 2-high safety structure. To the field (Trips side), the defense plays Quarters; to the boundary, it plays Cover 2 / Half.

beats.title: Quarters Bracket Activates on Trips
beats.text: As Z runs the deep post clearout, field safety SS and field corner RCB recognize H breaking on the deep out route, creating an inescapable inside-outside bracket.

beats.title: Flood Concept Suffocated
beats.text: SAM eliminates the flat throw to TE, RCB and SS lock the intermediate out route, and LCB squats on the boundary checkdown. The 3-level flood is completely dead.

beats.title: Pass Rush Closes In
beats.text: With the QB unable to trigger on his primary progression, the 4-man Wide-9 front collapses the pocket for the sack.

relations.tell: Field safety stays deep in Quarters alignment instead of buzzing down into the box at snap
